Honeycomb Shades

Honeycomb shades, also called cellular shades, fold into a compact stack. Their cellular structure traps air, bringing an insulating layer to the window along with a soft fabric finish.

Book a Consultation

A softer side to the window.

The small pleats make honeycomb shades easy to pair with a range of room styles. Compare fabric opacity with the daylight and privacy you want, then consider how the shade will sit within the opening. Your in-home consultation helps bring those choices into context.

What to consider

  • The balance of daylight and privacy
  • Fabric color against your walls and trim
  • How the shade fits within the window opening
